title: Foundations of Plant Stress Physiology
word_count_method: Count whitespace-separated tokens in p.teaching-prose after removing markup; exclude questions, tables, captions, references, navigation and revision.
comparison: Adjacent 6.G.10 has 13,533 teaching-prose words by the same method.
coverage: Stressors, strain, abiotic and biotic disturbance, homeostatic regulation and costs, primary and secondary injury, reversible inhibition and irreversible injury, intensity/duration/onset and dose response, genotype/developmental sensitivity, escape/avoidance/tolerance/resistance, acclimation vs adaptation, RWC/water potential/leakage/PSII fluorescence, growth/yield/survival/recovery, matched comparisons and factorial design. All roadmap topics addressed; molecular stress signaling and detailed immune pathways reserved for later nodes.
coverage_matrix: foundational definition, causal distinction, stress origin and regulation
Intensity, duration and rate of onset
distinguish exposure vs strain vs performance
heat conditioning, mutants and reciprocal tests
RWC, leakage, fluorescence, growth and recovery
review: Scientific pass: checked syllabus sources, terminology conventions, stress injury vs regulation, thermotolerance evidence (Hong & Vierling PMID 10760305; Queitsch DOI 10.1105/tpc.12.4.479), stress/strain review DOI 10.1093/jxb/erv497, Zhu Cell 2016, Skirycz et al. nbt.1800, fluorescence and herbivory references; checked all 52 answer stems and answer logic, recalculated RWC 65%, leakage 25%, Fv/Fm 0.8 and 0.6, RGR 0.153 and 0.093/day, recovery 0.50 and 0.83, factorial additive contrast −3 g and multiplicative expectation 12 g, harvest index 40% and 50%, and other arithmetic. Editorial pass: checked progressive 11-section sequence, duplicate prose, reference structure, figure labels, corrected feedback arrow and duplicate SVG attribute, randomized answer positions, preserved reader preferences and improved zoom focus return; added seven menu-backed crosslinks. Original datasets illustrative.
score_basis: Internal editorial assessment: deductions for limited exhaustive source review, some simpler distractors, lack of rendered SVG inspection and interactive/accessibility testing; not independent peer review.
limitations: Browser desktop/mobile rendering, keyboard interaction and screen-reader runtime not tested.

Selected reference records and syllabus documents checked; full-text line-by-line citation review and independent peer review not performed. MP SET syllabus checked via reproduced 2024 PDF, not independently confirmed latest official MPPSC copy.
GitHub Pages deployment and actual live content must be checked separately.
